Form input elements produce readable output without form mechanics

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{
		Preprocessing: &htmd.PreprocessingOptions{
			RemoveForms: ptr(false),
		},
	}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<form><label for="name">Name:</label><input type="text" id="name" placeholder="Enter name"></form>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
